title: Obtain a current SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter for GitHub Enterprise Cloud before 2026-09-30
description: Request through the GitHub Enterprise account the latest SOC 2 Type II report or an Ernst & Young bridge letter covering GitHub Enterprise Cloud: the only assurance on file (company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json assurance[0], E&Y, period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30) has expiresAt 2026-09-30, and no newer report period is published on github.com/trust-center or ghec.github.trust.page. File the artefact in the vendor assurance register recording issuer, period, scope and expiresAt, and hand it to the next refresh-vendor-ctx run so github.json assurance[] carries an entry whose expiresAt is later than 2026-09-30. Constraints: must complete before the current coverage lapses on 2026-09-30; verify the report scope still covers GitHub Enterprise Cloud including Actions and the package registry; record any exceptions with the vendor management response.
acceptanceCriteria: A SOC 2 Type II report for GitHub Enterprise Cloud with a period ending 2026-09-30 or later, or an Ernst & Young bridge letter extending the current report coverage beyond 2026-09-30, is filed in the vendor assurance register before 2026-09-30
The assurance register entry records issuer, periodStart, periodEnd, scope and an expiresAt later than 2026-09-30
company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json assurance[] shows a current soc2-type2 entry with expiresAt later than 2026-09-30 after the next refresh-vendor-ctx run

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer opens the filed SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter and its assurance register entry and confirms the reporting period, the GitHub Enterprise Cloud scope and an expiresAt later than 2026-09-30, satisfying SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S4 and RBI Outsourcing Risk Directions 2025 para 79; expected result: current, in-scope assurance exists on file for github before the 2026-09-30 lapse

rootCause.description: GitHub publishes no newer SOC 2 Type II period on its public trust pages and the company never pulled the current report or a bridge letter through its Enterprise account, so the only assurance artefact on file (period ending 2025-09-30, bridge coverage expiring 2026-09-30) lapses with nothing replacing it
